text:
mina: Quick heads-up — starting q6b-int4 bring-up now. Seeing a tiny regression on longform summarization slices, want to kick off a focused sampling + golden refresh for the affected intents. Anyone on curation team available to help pick 1k targeted examples? :eyes:
jordan: I can carve out an hour after stand. Do we have the slice definitions?
mina: Yes — fragile_long_summ, attrition_dialog, and code-doc mismatch. Planning stratified sampling: 60% fragile_long_summ, 25% attrition_dialog, 15% code-doc.
sam: tagging label-bot to enqueue a run. label-bot: queued sample job id sam-176234 — SQL: ```SELECT id, prompt FROM samplebank WHERE slice IN ('fragile_long_summ','attrition_dialog','code_doc_mismatch') ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1000;``` ETA ~12m. :robot_face:
anya: Quick question — do we want to dedupe by fingerprint first? Last time we had paraphrase collisions in the golden and it skewed evals.
mina: Good call. Add dedupe stage with fuzzyhash threshold 0.88 before labeler. Sam — can label-bot add that?
sam: yep. updating pipeline: ```pipeline: [filter_by_slice, fuzzy_dedupe(thresh=0.88), stratified_sample, human_review]``` will run after current queue.
jordan: Also, for quant smoke, can we attach the q6b-int4 outputs and a q8b-int3 baseline to the sample so evals can run side-by-side? We should collect token-level diffs and a small composite metric (EM-like + summary-rouge delta).
mina: Absolutely. Devx: can you add artifact links + a simple comparator script to the job?
devx-cog: On it. I'll push a tiny comparator: ```python
# comparator pseudocode
for id in sample: compute_metrics(q6b_out, baseline_out); save_csv()
``` Expect artifact URL in thread when finished.
anya: Labeler capacity heads-up: we have ~400 backlog. If this job is 1k and needs golden labels, can we do micro-golden (150 core golden, rest fast-review)?
mona? I mean mina: micro-golden sounds right. Keep 150 golden; route remaining to expedited 2x annotators.
jordan: +1. Also add a metric tag so we can later slice by 'quant_regression_check' in the console.
sam: sample job completed and dedup applied — sending first 150 earmarked for golden. label-bot: artifacts: s3://redwood-curation/sam-176234/outputs/ — includes csv + dedupe-log.txt :white_check_mark:
mina: Perfect. Once comparator runs, let's meet 30m after to triage any structural regressions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
